name: What is the process for updating kitchen finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for updating kitchen finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for updating kitchen finishes typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and material preferences. Next, we provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, we schedule the work. The project usually starts with protecting surrounding areas and preparing surfaces, followed by the installation of new cabinets or refacing, countertop replacement, backsplash installation, flooring, and finally, plumbing and lighting fixture updates. We ensure clear communication throughout each stage, managing trades and minimizing disruption until your new kitchen is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design proposal, scheduling, site preparation, installation of new finishes (cabinets, counters, backsplash, floor, fixtures), and final walkthrough.
